title: PCG: rooms do not connect and the floor plan does not read as a castle
Player is too tall for the rooms (scale mismatch between character and architecture)
No crosshair - cannot tell where you are aiming
Mouse is not locked or hidden during play
Player can still move and look around while the main menu is open
Enemies have no animations
No animations for the player or for doors
No visual feedback for taking or dealing damage
No visual feedback for spells
No usable health or damage model - nothing is distinguishable in play
No carryable objects placed in the level - picking anything up is not discoverable
Main menu has no art
Only one era (High Medieval) has art and models
No way to test combat
Modules float and snap inconsistently - grid spacing must be exact
Loot is flung across the map by physics at spawn
No portal - no asset and no way to travel to or from the lair
No VFX or SFX anywhere - spells, attacks, UI and casting failures are all silent
Castles look bland
EPIC: build the game loop end to end so there is something to actually play
Player spawn can be inside or flush against castle geometry
